purpose: Select one exact Campaign067 historical-only accounting-efficiency candidate after Campaign066, using definitions and schema evidence only, before reading any Campaign067 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_inventory.numeric_order_rule: Reproduce all 96 Campaign066 numeric comparisons in their frozen order and append quarterly_quality_rank_balance_3f/higher exactly once.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The fixed difference between cross-sectional ROE rank and net-profit-scale rank measures profitability efficiency not explained by absolute earnings scale. It is not another dispersion transform of Campaign066 and introduces no fitted coefficient, threshold, window, or subset.
A different range, standard deviation, median, skew, or pairwise operator would be a post-terminal reformulation of Campaign066 rather than a new mechanism.
Those definitions already exist in the complete historical comparison library.
A standalone net-profit rank is primarily an earnings-size proxy and does not isolate capital efficiency.
Regression residualization would add training and estimator choices before a simpler parameter-free rank gap is tested.
No board, year, size bucket, threshold, market regime, minute interaction, or favorable subset is searched.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_roe_profit_scale_efficiency_gap_2r
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Companies whose already-public ROE rank is high relative to their absolute net-profit rank may display stronger capital efficiency than accounting scale alone implies, creating a distinct short-horizon repricing signal.
selected_candidate.formula: At each stock day, compute separate average-tie cross-sectional percentile ranks r_roe and r_net_profit over the exact frozen stock-day identity rows having both already-effective values finite, then return r_roe - r_net_profit.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: Each disclosure becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort by instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date, then keep the last row per instrument and effective session.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill roe and net_profit independently inside each instrument after strict effective-session ordering; never backfill from a later disclosure.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each stock day use pandas-compatible average-tie percentile ranks on the common finite two-field identity cross-section.
selected_candidate.combination_rule: Exactly r_roe minus r_net_profit; coefficients are fixed at +1 and -1 and are not fitted.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both already-effective fields and both ranks are finite. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, backfill, or select a favorable report.

decision.next_action: Perform a complete 98-definition mechanism-overlap audit, then freeze the 97-comparator coverage-first protocol before reading source or candidate values.
